title: Latin rhythms and the repertoire
summary: Charles says they played rhumbas and anything they could pick up.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What we played: tunes and repertoire in the early days

blocks.x: Did the musicians, I had already asked if you used any Cajun folk songs from this area, you said no. Were there any musicians from Latin America, you know, South America, that came in there that at any time that your group heard play or that played with you, that would give you any, say, Latin rhythms? Do you recall any kind of music of this kind being used?

You didn't play any rhombos? No. Well we played rhombos. You did? We just, you know, from the music. And then we put on whatever part we wanted in there, you see. But we played rhombos and music. In other words we played all kinds of music. Couldn't name a piece of music that we didn't play.
What would be the head numbers you'd play?
Well anything we could think of that we picked up from hearing the other fellow play.
